LanguageData.RimLazy_SelectMap: Select a colony map to manage its work.
LanguageData.RimLazy_EnableManual: Enable manual priorities in the game's Work tab to apply a plan.
LanguageData.RimLazy_Undone: Restored the priorities from before the last application.
LanguageData.RimLazy_AllocationHelp: Set a minimum share of work time for each goal. The weights divide the remaining time. Equal weights receive equal shares.
LanguageData.RimLazy_InvalidMinimum: Minimum shares total {0}%. Reduce them to 100% or less to continue.
LanguageData.RimLazy_PreserveRemainder: Keep existing priorities for spare labor when all remaining weights are zero
LanguageData.RimLazy_ZeroKeep: With all weights at zero, the remaining {0}% has no strategic target. Existing priorities are kept for spare labor.
LanguageData.RimLazy_ZeroLeave: With all weights at zero, the remaining {0}% is left unassigned. Applying can turn off managed work types.
LanguageData.RimLazy_NamePreset: Enter a name to save the current strategy in this map.
LanguageData.RimLazy_NoCapture: Could not read work types. Preview again to refresh.
LanguageData.RimLazy_OverrideHint: Planning limit for this map. Use 0 for the full work-table range. Change the number of work-table levels in RimLazy mod settings.
LanguageData.RimLazy_MappingHelp: Assign work types to goals. Columns set to “Keep existing” retain each colonist's current priority.
LanguageData.RimLazy_NoWorkers: No eligible colonists on this map.
LanguageData.RimLazy_LocksHelp: Select a colonist above. Check a work type to keep that colonist’s current priority when applying a plan.
LanguageData.RimLazy_PreviewFirst: Preview an allocation to see estimated work shares and changed priorities.
LanguageData.RimLazy_ResultsHelp: Estimated shares assume available tasks. Actual hours depend on jobs, materials and travel.
LanguageData.RimLazy_Reason_Capacity: Available work or capacity is limited
LanguageData.RimLazy_Reason_PriorityOrder: Limited by available priorities or other assignments
